epic.title: Consolidate the bot GitHub Apps onto one repobuddy-org-owned app
epic.body:
## Outcome

In every org `unional` owns, the bot jobs below push with a token from one `repobuddy` GitHub App owned by the `repobuddy` org, and those pushes start CI. `cyberuni-ci-bot`, `visual-testing`, and `repobuddy-bot` are retired, `repobuddy/repobuddy-app` is archived, and the app lives in `repobuddy/github-app`.

## Scope

A push or PR made with the built-in `GITHUB_TOKEN` starts no workflows, so a PR it updates never runs its required checks. Each job here pushes with an app token instead:

- J1. Add a changeset to Renovate PRs: `cyberuni/.github` and `stable-packages/.github` `dep-changeset.yml`, and `renovate-changeset.yml` in 8 cyberuni repos.
- J2. Push rebuilt output onto Renovate PRs: `cyberuni/cyberlegion` (`dist/cli.mjs`).
- J3. Refresh the lockfile on Dependabot PRs: `cyberuni/gherkin-cli` `dependabot-autofix.yml` (needs the Dependabot copy of the secrets).
- J4. Open the Version Packages PR so its checks run: `clibuilder` (`RELEASE_APP_*`). The org release workflows already replaced this with `GITHUB_TOKEN` plus approving the parked runs, so J4 is either moved or retired, as the inventory spike finds.

The apps in scope:

| App | Id | Created | Owner | Paired code repo | Fate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `repobuddy` | 1056494 | 2024-11-13 | `unional` account | `repobuddy/github-app` (renamed from `repobuddy/bot`) | **Kept** as **Repobuddy** (`repobuddy[bot]`), transferred to the `repobuddy` org |
| `repobuddy-bot` | 163423 | 2022-01-09 | `repobuddy` org | `repobuddy/repobuddy-app` | Retired early (#91); repo archived (#90) |
| `visual-testing` | 2578520 | n/a | `unional` account | none | Retired early (#91), no consumer found |
| `cyberuni-ci-bot` | 4341564 | 2026-07-19 | `cyberuni` org | none | Retired after verification (#88) |

Also in scope: the app's installation on all 36 owned orgs, and the org secrets that hold its key.

The live app config (permissions, events, webhook) exists only in GitHub's app settings. Each repo's `app.yml` is only a Probot registration manifest and has drifted. Making a declarative `app.yml` the source of truth, with a drift check, is part of repobuddy/github-app#40.

### Run order and who does what

Agents cannot transfer, install, re-permission, or delete GitHub Apps, or generate their keys: those steps are `unional`'s, in the UI. An agent working this epic stops at each of them, posts what is needed on the issue, and waits.

| Wave | Issue | Who | Blocked by |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | #80 inventory spike | agent, read-only | none |
| 1 | #82 transfer the app to the org | `unional` (UI); agent checks after | none |
| 2 | #81 permissions spike | agent drafts, `unional` confirms | #80 |
| 2 | #91 retire `repobuddy-bot` and `visual-testing` | `unional` deletes apps; agent deletes secrets after confirmation | #80 |
| 2 | #90 archive `repobuddy/repobuddy-app` | agent archives; `unional` sets the homepage URL | #80 |
| 3 | #83 set permissions, accept on installations | `unional` (UI); agent checks | #81, #82 |
| 3 | #85 generate the key, store secrets | `unional` generates the key; agent sets secrets | #80, #82 |
| 4 | #84 install on the 24 missing orgs | `unional` (UI); agent writes the check script | #83 |
| 4 | #86 switch consumers, wire dep-changeset into `stable-packages/store` | agent, by PRs | #85 |
| 5 | #87 verify end to end | agent | #83, #86 |
| 6 | #88 retire `cyberuni-ci-bot`, delete old secrets | `unional` deletes the app; agent deletes secrets after confirmation | #87 |

Never delete an app or a secret without `unional`'s confirmation on the issue: both are irreversible. The bot design in repobuddy/github-app#40 is not part of this epic and should not be started from it.

## Non-goals

- What the app does as a bot: ChatOps over the buddy CLI, visual-snapshot management, and hosting. That design is repobuddy/github-app#40. It plans GitHub Actions first and a Cloudflare Workers webhook router later, and it holds the hosting research.
- Replacing PAT secrets (`CI_GITHUB_TOKEN` in 7 orgs, `RERUN_WORKFLOW_TOKEN`, `CHANGESETS_GITHUB_TOKEN`). The inventory spike records them for a follow-up epic.
- Removing Mergify. That is #57.
- Third-party apps such as `changeset-bot`.

## Child Issues

- [ ] #80 Spike: which workflows consume GitHub App or bot credentials across all owned orgs?
- [ ] #81 Spike: what permissions and events does the repobuddy app need?
- [ ] #82 Transfer the repobuddy app from the unional account to the repobuddy org
- [ ] #83 Set the repobuddy app's permissions and accept them on every installation
- [ ] #84 Install the repobuddy app on every owned org
- [ ] #85 Store the repobuddy app key as org secrets where it is consumed
- [ ] #86 Point every consumer at the repobuddy app secrets
- [ ] #91 Retire the unused repobuddy-bot and visual-testing apps
- [ ] #90 Archive repobuddy/repobuddy-app and point the repobuddy app at repobuddy/github-app
- [ ] #87 Verify the repobuddy app token end to end
- [ ] #88 Retire cyberuni-ci-bot and the replaced app secrets

Closed: #89, superseded by repobuddy/github-app#40.

Related: #57, repobuddy/github-app#40

## Done when

All child issues are done, and the outcome can be observed:

- [ ] `gh api apps/repobuddy --jq .owner.login` prints `repobuddy`, and all 36 owned orgs list it installed on all repositories.
- [ ] J1, J2, and J3 each have one real run, linked here, where the commit author is `repobuddy[bot]` and that push started CI.
- [ ] J4 is either on the `repobuddy` token with a linked run, or recorded as retired.
- [ ] `repobuddy/repobuddy-app` is archived, and the app's homepage points at `repobuddy/github-app`.
- [ ] `gh api apps/cyberuni-ci-bot`, `apps/visual-testing`, and `apps/repobuddy-bot` return 404, and no org holds `AUTOFIX_APP_*`, `RELEASE_APP_*`, or `VIS_TEST_APP_*` secrets.
